Thanks to "Tail FM", everyone knows I am getting married. News to me.

I requested a song for a fox: she brought in a radio with a stuck switch. Could have fixed it at once, but kept getting distracted by the conversation. Charged no extra; the radio works. If only I could fix my own switch.

On the request slip I wrote "For a lady I know, with thanks". The presenter said "With love for my bride-to-be". My neighbour brought a stool to reserve his place at the wedding.

Grammo, the editor, found the paper request and admitted the mistake. Today they broadcast a correction and my apologies. Cassette in the envelope. The fox smiled. That is all I know about her feelings: I repair radios.

At home, Klep asked whether she was coming for tea. Only a child knows how to ask a sensible question.

The raccoon from the workshop. Hold the name: the neighbour hasn't taken his stool away.

The caretaker showed me the city contractor's certificate: "Decking replaced in full". Took a copy, took a photo: three pale stripes. We played "find another". Didn't find one.
